name: GPS_TIME
description: Nanoseconds since GPS epoch (remember to update the leap second tables!)

name: RTP_TIMESNAP
description: snapshot of current real-time-protocol timestamp, for linking RTP timestamps to clock time via GPS_TIME

name: SPECTRUM_BASE
description: base level of 1-byte analyzer data, dB

name: SPECTRUM_AVG
description: Number of FFTs averaged into each spectrum response

name: DIRECT_CONVERSION
description: Boolean indicating SDR is direct conversion -- should avoid DC

name: OUTPUT_CHANNELS
description: 1 or 2 in Linear and WFM, 1 in FM

name: DEMOD_OVERRANGES
description: # of samples since last A/D overrange

name: OPUS_FEC
description: Opus encoder forward error correction loss rate, %

name: SPECTRUM_STEP
description: size of byte spectrum data level step, dB
